Dimensions: threshold/date comparison (ignore / non-strict / strict), scope, exception (ignore / any category / read), cross-reference (ignore / article token only / read), unstated attribute (ignore / read), negation.

## Identifiability of the benchmark

Number of test items (of 2,560) on which a one-dimension deviation from the reference rule changes the prediction. Zero means the test set cannot tell that deviation apart from the correct rule.
